subject: general
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters will replace the question mark (?) and complete the following letter-cluster series?

MNA, WDB, EVA, KPB, OLA, ?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba9641975f2fc7524ff111ee5de92ae0deecda54903f9932e1bcb1ebbbc99a46.png] 

**Logic:** First and Second letters in the row are coded according to the equivalent opposite letter of a particular letter of the word.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a104a2fa9e201448e44be1549d3fde1a791f5e69b952351f24c21b35bdcd8db.png] 

Hence, '**QJB**' is the correct answer.
